label: Outerwear
description: Named coats, jackets, blazers, capes, ponchos and outer vests as individual garments.
notes: Individual outer layers belong here, including tailored jackets and sleeveless outer vests. Complete ensembles belong in person.outfit.cold_weather or person.outfit.formal; hats belong in clothing.headwear and shoes in clothing.footwear. Values are single garment names that follow wearing, with no specified color. Revivable and ceremonial styles remain available in contemporary scenes, and garment names do not imply descent.
